target.title: fix(usage): guard malformed Gemini quota buckets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gemini usage fetch iterates `data.buckets` with `data.buckets || []`. When the API returns a non-array truthy value such as `{}`, the loop throws because objects are not iterable, and the usage snapshot path fails instead of degrading to empty windows.

## Why This Change Was Made

In `src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.gemini.ts`, normalize `buckets` with `Array.isArray` before iteration, and skip non-object entries so malformed quota payloads cannot crash the fetch path.

## User Impact

**Before:** A malformed Gemini quota response with non-array `buckets` could throw during usage fetch.
**After:** Non-array `buckets` are treated as empty; usage returns no windows and no error for that shape.

## Evidence

Branch: `codex/gemini-usage-buckets-boundary` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v24.18.0 — Windows

### Regression tests

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.gemini.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > returns HTTP errors for failed requests
 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > returns a stable error for malformed successful usage JSON
 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > selects the lowest remaining fraction per model family
 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > returns no windows when the response has no recognized model families
 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > treats a non-array buckets object as empty without erroring
 ✓ fetchGeminiUsage > defaults missing fractions to fully available and clamps invalid fractions

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

- New test proves `{ buckets: {} }` returns no error, empty windows, and correct provider/displayName.
- Existing Gemini usage normalization cases remain green.

### Diff summary

```
src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.gemini.ts       | 7 ++++++- (Array.isArray + non-object skip)
src/infra/provider-usage.fetch.gemini.test.ts  | 17 +++++++++++++++++ (malformed buckets regression)
```

What was not tested: live Gemini quota API responses; only mocked fetch payloads.

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
